about_the_game:
Years Gone By is the natural following episode of the other Fineam Neo Studio Production.

This time with better game-play, graphics, sounds and game mechanics, though.

The game has been developed in Java (thanks to @KaarinGaming).

The game has 5 levels that will test your ability and sharpness in order to defeat all the enemies in each level.

Completing a level means beating all the nasty creatures that invaded your beloved paradise.

Be wary of the difficult environment and terrain and remember, you are a knight and your armor prevents you to swim!

Controls for the game are:

Arrow keys <- -> to move left and right

Space bar to jump

Left click mouse to light attack

Right click mouse to use a special attack ( needs action bar points )

There's a bit more to say, but why not find out yourself? ;-)

The game is not very resource hungry so should run pretty much everywhere.
